name: ANGRAMM
description: ANGRAMM is a creative agency and audiovisual production company in Marseille: films for Olympique de Marseille, Lacoste, Mizuno, adidas, Kappa, Umbro and Crocs.
intro: ANGRAMM is a creative agency and audiovisual production company. Driven by major collaborations with high-profile partners, we bring our creative and technical expertise to any industry, both in France and internationally.

text: An engram is the trace a memory leaves in the brain. This is where ANGRAMM comes from: images that stay with people.
We are a creative agency and audiovisual production company, in France and abroad. Led by instinct, shaped by craft, we create as one artist with many hands.
